jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a REAL TRANSPARENT PNG GAME SPRITE ATLAS, not a mockup or illustration scene. Reference image is STYLE and IDENTITY reference: selected Maifeld-Detailpixel with warm comic pixel clusters, dark blue-brown outlines, upper-left light, material shading, distinct faces. Preserve the exact character identity described. Output landscape canvas 2048x1024, exactly 8 columns x 4 rows, 32 isolated sprites of ONE SAME character. Generous transparent gutters, every silhouette and held implement completely inside cell with at least 18 pixels empty margin. NO letters, NO numbers, NO grid lines, NO backdrop, NO shadows, NO detached effects or particles. Genuine alpha. Fixed body proportions, consistent garments and implement across all frames. Same slightly elevated RPG camera in all rows. Direction rows: row1 front three-quarter facing screen RIGHT (southeast); row2 front three-quarter facing screen LEFT (southwest); row3 BACK three-quarter facing screen RIGHT (northeast), back of head/clothing visible; row4 BACK three-quarter facing screen LEFT (northwest). The back rows must really show the back, NOT copies of the front. Within each row eight columns: 1 neutral idle, 2 walking left foot forward, 3 walking passing stride, 4 walking right foot forward, 5 attack anticipation pulling implement or head back, 6 attack impact extending implement or lunging head forward, 7 focused special action braced and raised implement (animal: threatening snort lowered head), 8 recoil from being hit. Keep ground baseline and character size consistent, no zoom or scale variation. This is a game animation source for a 52-native-pixel-high human, not smooth vector art. Clean deliberate pixel clusters; do not add micro-noise.
ONLY Aperol-Anni from the reference first row: adult woman blonde hair bun, dark sunglasses atop head, gold hoop earrings, orange floral blouse, cream gingham waist apron tied with bow visible from back, dark green fitted trousers, brown boots, small makeup brush held in anatomical RIGHT hand. Teal spray bottle attached to waist. Friendly mischievous face. Same identity from all four directions.
